Name: Denver for Mobile Phone
Author: ShatteredEffect
Description:
Yet another mobile phone patch. 

There are technically two mods in here, as with the other patches I've made. One that adds the events to the phone, and another that makes Denver's dialogue from the Custom NPC - Denver mod when answering and saying goodbye on the phone more unique (this does not change his in game dialogue). I haven't quite figured out how to combine them in an effective way yet, but I am hoping to combine them in the future. 

I would like to thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60742951][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45507937]whitebalverines[/url] for the creation and building of Denver, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] for making this all possible through their Mobile phone mod. (Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] for helping me figure out some kinks that I was having in the code!)

You can find both of their mods here (note, they are required for this mod!)
Custom NPC - Denver by whitebalverines: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4594
Mobile Phone by aedenthorn: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523

Installation: 
1: This mod requires SMAPI and content patcher, so make sure you have both installed to the specifications listed on their pages. 
2: Make sure that both Denver and Mobile phone are installed to the standards listed on their individual pages (including all required mods for them)
3: Either download Denver for Mobile Phone via your mod manager, or manually
﻿a: If you do it via manager that should be it, please enjoy the mod and let me know if you run into any issues! I will do my best to sort them out. 
﻿b: If you do it manually, then manually extract the file into your mod folder, then you should be ready to go!

There is a config file in [CP] Denver - Mobile phone greetings, the only thing it does is turns the adjusted greetings and goodbyes on or off. I'm hoping to expand upon it more as I have more time. 

Thanks again, and please enjoy the mod. :)

Things planned for the future: 

Adding more greetings based on relationship to the Denver and other villagers. 
Possibly adding Mobile Phone support for more followers, based on if I get permission from the authors.
